notes.title: Mementus Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
As promised, our team continues to improve Primordials of Amyrion, and this patch brings yet another bundle of changes that include some new content and much-needed improvements. We thank you for all your feedback and comments; they were crucial in making this update. As we stated before, they are invaluable to us, and we hope you will continue to help us make Primordials of Amyrion better with each passing month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37909553/dc0b18906802989004dc6ac092e44c40f3b583af.jpg[/img]

[b]0.3.36 Patch notes:[/b]

[b]Secondary Primordial ability[/b]
All Primordials will now have two different and unique abilities controlled by the player. Each Primordial will have one localized ability with its unique, recognizable telegraph and one overall global ability. This way, Primordials will have an even more vital role in each match and further improve the strategic decision-making aspect of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37909553/3ce869b44552101d5e46ef45ebfdafad9e040e94.jpg[/img]

[b]Currency change[/b]
From now on, upgrade planning will be easier since all upgrades will only cost gold. Essence will remain as one of the currencies but with a whole new role entirely.

[b]Essence change[/b]
Essence change brings yet another major development in Primordials of Amyrion. From now on, players will be able to re-cast Champion abilities at the cost of Essence, giving them a new mechanic to use in the upcoming battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37909553/29c3d0637038daa92de510667597142ec22b4fa7.jpg[/img]

[b]New UI[/b]
A whole new UI was designed to simplify the gaming experience and enable faster in-game response with easier decision making.

[b]New upgrade mechanics[/b]
As we decided to simplify some aspects of gameplay and make it more enjoyable, upgrades were changed across the board.

Unit upgrades are now much more straightforward and simplified for a better user experience. All units are divided into three sections (Infantry, Ranged, and Calvary), and with one click, the entire section may be upgraded as opposed to single-unit upgrades used so far.

[b]New Primordial introduction[/b]
Last but certainly not least is the introduction of Mementus the Age Sovereign! The Lord of Time joins the battle for dominion, thus giving players new useful tactics to experience. While his brethren control elements and metal, Mementus uses time itself as a weapon of war.

notes.title: Dual Towers Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
We’ve just released the first content update to our Early Access game, Primordials of Amyrion!  You can download the free update automatically when navigating to your purchased game on Steam.  

The Dual Towers Update features new Champion voice-overs, new dual towers with tower upgrades, as well as many player enhancements such as improved UI, friend-listing, chat and invites, and new map textures and improvements

[previewyoutube=l3NX36_tLBM;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re dedicated to continuing to update Primordials of Amyrion in ways both big and small with new content and game patches, and more is to come very shortly that allow for more exciting gameplay options and continued improvements.  See you on the battlefield!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37909553/8b2ed51a34f182ddb2fc8e476ea1a33647bf5b5f.png[/img]	

0.3.35 Patch notes:

[b]Friend list, Chat, and Challenge[/b]
Players will have a new option to invite other players to their friend list and make the game even more social, especially in these trying times. Once the friend invite is accepted, players will be given the possibility to communicate via Chat or to Challenge each other for a friendly match. With the Challenge option, players will skip the usual queue for available players and immediately enter the game.

[b]Player Avatar & Win/Loss track[/b]
All players will gain access to the Avatar library. Simply by clicking on the avatar in the top right corner, the library will open, and players will be able to change their avatars with a simple click. For now, the library is populated by our characters from the game from Minions to Champions, but in further updates, there will be many more options to customize your visuals.

[b]Map improvements[/b]
All map assets have improved textures to ensure the better visual quality of the game and give you that eye candy feeling everyone desires.

[b]Outer tower relocation[/b]
One of the major changes to the game is our new dual-tower setup. Outer towers have been moved to the opposite side of inner towers, thus ensuring better tower longevity and stronger defense.

[b]Tower upgrade[/b]
As we decided to simplify some aspects of gameplay mad make it more enjoyable, the first to be reworked were the Tower upgrades. From now on, ALL the towers will be simultaneously upgraded with each upgrade purchase. This way, the loss of a tower seems less punishing and reduces the need to upgrade each individual tower.

notes.title: PRIMORDIALS OPEN BETA IS NOW LIVE – PLAY FREE ALL WEEK LONG!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37909553/7c6676f5daa31b26365a27354a3a3f16b4da6764.jpg[/img]

We’ve just launched Open Beta for Primordials of Amyrion on Steam, available to all players for free from now until September 21st, at 11am ET.

The new Open Beta build has all-new Champions to try out – the celestial magic of Armaros, and the fiery magic of Angie.New Primordials are also part of this Open Beta – featuring the healing properties of Vellamon, along with Yordian, who defends his realm and turns his opponents into stone.

All the previous Primordials, Champions, and Realms also make their way back in this Open Beta, making it the deepest version of the game we’ve released yet.  So choose your draft picks carefully, and engage in epic 1 v 1 tug of war battles today!

[previewyoutube=g8dcjdGdZEY;full][/previewyoutube]

OUR FOCUS FOR THIS OPEN BETA TEST

[list]
[*] Server stability
[*] Ability functions and responsiveness
[*] General impressions of the game, its mechanics and stability
[*] Champion stats balance
[*] Champion abilities balance
[*] Realm balance
[*] Primordial ability balance
[*] Audio response and synchronization
[*] VFX
[/list]

Have fun and don’t forget to join our [url=https://primordials.game/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/discord@2x.png]Discord [/url]and send us all your thoughts and feedback!

And don’t forget to wishlist Primordials of Amyrion on Steam or the Epic Games store, and jump into Early Access launch on October 6th!

notes.title: PRIMORDIALS BETA IS NOW LIVE – PLAY FREE NOW!
notes.content:
The Primordials of Amyrion Beta is now available for free to all players on Steam!  We hope that you have a great time trying out the game and helping us shape it for the Early Access launch on October 6th.

Along with new Champions and a new Primordial to try out, we’ve reworked the game with upgradeable units that add an additional layer to the 1v1 macro strategy game.

You can jump sign up [url=https://primordials.game/closed-beta-sign-up/]here[/url] for a Steam key that the team will quickly send to you!

Even the unstoppable advance of Trakay supported by their power-hungry Sting bud can be countered with the decisive strike of Elborg’s Hoarfrost, deployed in just the right moment.

[previewyoutube=aMA5RfxAI5k;full][/previewyoutube]

OUR FOCUS FOR THIS BETA TEST

[list]
[*] Server stability
[*] Ability functions and responsiveness
[*] General impressions of the game, its mechanics and stability
[*] Champion stats balance
[*] Champion abilities balance
[*] Realm balance
[*] Primordial ability balance
[*] Audio response and synchronization
[*] VFX
[/list]

Please share your experience with your friends, have fun and send us all your thoughts and feedback!
We hope you will have a lot of fun through the playtest, and all your feedback will be much appreciated.

See you soon on the battlegrounds of Primordials of Amyrion!
